commands.name: format
command:
set -eu
uname -a
cargo --version
rustfmt --version
rustc -vV
rustc -vV | grep -Fx 'host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu'
cargo --version | grep -F 'cargo 1.96.0 '
rustfmt --version | grep -F 'rustfmt 1.9.0-stable '
mkdir /tmp/source
tar -xf - -C /tmp/source
cd /tmp/source
source_fingerprint() {
  find lampOS -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum
  find lampOS -type l -printf '%p -> %l\n' | LC_ALL=C sort
}
source_fingerprint > /tmp/source-before.sha256
printf 'source-before-manifest '
sha256sum /tmp/source-before.sha256
cd lampOS
set +e
cargo fmt --all --check
format_status=$?
set -e
cd ..
source_fingerprint > /tmp/source-after.sha256
printf 'source-after-manifest '
sha256sum /tmp/source-after.sha256
if ! cmp -s /tmp/source-before.sha256 /tmp/source-after.sha256; then
  diff -u /tmp/source-before.sha256 /tmp/source-after.sha256 >&2 || true
  printf 'source changed during formatting check\n' >&2
  exit 125
fi
printf 'cargo_fmt_exit=%s\n' "$format_status"
exit "$format_status"
